You will be given a batch of customer messages sent to AmazonHelp on Twitter. For each message, identify the primary customer intent/issue category.

Respond in JSON format:
{

      "description": "One-line description of this intent",
      "message_indices": [0, 3, 7],
      "count": 3

}
